# Herald Ago - Product Designer

> Portfolio of Herald Ago, a Product Designer based in Padua, Italy (MSc in IT - Web Communication Design, University of Southern Denmark). 3+ years of international experience across Denmark, Spain, and Italy, combining empirical user research, design systems, CRO/A/B testing, and WCAG 2.2 accessibility.

## Profile

- Role: Product Designer
- Location: Padua, Italy
- Education: MSc in IT - Web Communication Design (University of Southern Denmark), BSc in Communication (University of Ferrara)
- Languages: Italian (Native), English (C1), Spanish (B1), French (B1)
- Contact: heraldago1@gmail.com
- LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/in/heraldago/

## Primary Case Studies

- [Ungdomskort Redesign](https://www.heraldago.com/ungdomskort): National Danish student transit pass website and app redesign, WCAG 2.2 AA compliant.
- [X-Bit Museum Companion App](https://www.heraldago.com/xbit): End-to-end mobile app design process completed as part of the Google UX Design Certificate.
- [I Pupi Siciliani Wine E-Commerce](https://www.heraldago.com/ipupisiciliani): End-to-end UX/UI, product photography, and custom WooCommerce build in Odense, Denmark (+31% gross, +187% YoY net profit).
- [Sydbank Enterprise Data Catalog](https://www.heraldago.com/sydbank): Empirical 24-person survey and UI redesign reducing task times by 66% at Denmark's 4th largest bank.
- [Tutora EdTech Platform](https://www.heraldago.com/tutora): Tutoring marketplace and design system.

## Research & Navigation

- [MSc Thesis: Gamified Coding Pedagogy](https://www.heraldago.com/thesis): Empirical study (N = 24, 4-week experiment) reducing coding task completion time by 50%.
